channel.title: Portman AI — Practical Agentic Systems
channel.description: Essays on building production-grade LLM and agentic systems, by Danny Portman.

item.title: MCP in Production: What the Tutorials Don't Cover
item.description: MCP server best practices for production: credential scoping, schema versioning, error design, idempotency, and the observability that tutorials skip.

item.title: The Real Cost of an Agent: A Token Economics Field Guide
item.description: LLM agent cost optimization: why context growth and retries dominate the bill, four levers that cut spend 5–10x, and a worksheet for estimating cost per run.

item.title: Evals Before Agents: The Order of Operations Nobody Follows
item.description: How to test LLM agents: a minimum viable eval stack with a 30-case golden set, three kinds of graders, and a CI regression gate. Build it before the agent.

item.title: Your Agent Doesn't Need More Autonomy. It Needs Better Boundaries.
item.description: Why constrained AI agents with tool allowlists, step caps, and approval gates beat fully autonomous agent loops in production.
